title: Squidward Walking
blurb: Squelch, squelch, existential dread, squelch. Those suction-cupped footsteps belong to a man trudging towards a job he openly despises, at an establishment he considers beneath him, for a boss who is a crab. It has become the official sound of reluctant motion — walking into the office, approaching a task you have dodged for eleven days, returning to the gym in week two of January. Lay it under any defeated walk in an edit and the walk becomes cinema. Nobody has animated resignation more accurately with four legs and no dialogue.
origin: Squidward's distinctive walking sound from SpongeBob SquarePants.
